test_dependencies.name: Chrome for Testing
test_dependencies.license: Google Chrome Terms of Service plus Chromium and bundled third-party notices exposed by chrome://credits
test_dependencies.scope: Test-only isolated MV3 browser runtime; local ignored build cache only; excluded from product package
test_dependencies.lifecycle: Downloaded as one immutable HTTPS archive, integrity checked before extraction, never installed system-wide
test_dependencies.network: Forced through a local deny-by-default proxy; only fixture.example.invalid:443 maps to the local fixture server
test_dependencies.telemetry: Launched with a fresh temporary profile, metrics/background networking/component updates/sync disabled, and every non-fixture request denied and logged
test_dependencies.generated_code: Prebuilt browser executable and resources; no source incorporated into the product
test_dependencies.permissions: Executes only for the opt-in macOS browser integration test; no user browser profile or credentials
test_dependencies.maintenance: Official Chrome for Testing availability listed 153.0.8010.36 as Stable on 2026-09-12; the official Chrome release blog announced Chrome 153 stable on 2026-09-08
test_dependencies.advisory_review: Official Chrome 153.0.8010.36 stable release notes report 230 security fixes. The initially Playwright-pinned early-stable 153.0.8010.12 artifact was rejected after this check and replaced before final evidence; current-stable status is not proof that no vulnerability remains.
test_dependencies.signature_review: Outer test app is not distribution-signed; codesign --verify --deep --strict reports an invalid resource seal. The launcher is linker ad-hoc signed. Integrity therefore relies on the pinned HTTPS URL and exact archive/executable SHA-256 values.
test_dependencies.excluded_components: Playwright FFmpeg revision 1011 and Chromium headless-shell revision 1243 were disclosed by dry-run but were not downloaded or executed. Early-stable Chrome 153.0.8010.12 was downloaded and exercised during pre-adoption verification, then rejected as superseded; it is ignored local quarantine only and cannot satisfy the runner hash gate.
test_dependencies.decision: allow this exact archive for local test execution only after hash verification; block on any URL, version, platform, or hash drift
